description: NT-12: the time budget of each run tier per application, in minutes of the application's own time (opening, probing and saving each file), and the model that turns a tier's files and slides into that time. Read by check:native-coverage (rule d) and report:native-coverage. A tier over its budget fails the check: move decks to a later tier, merge decks that show the same units, or raise the budget here in the same pull request with a reason.

keynote.note: Seconds per file and per slide, fitted on 584 Keynote opens of 2026-11-25 and 2026-11-27 (the native-test corpus study of 2026-11-27, owner's option A): modeled seconds = 4.15 x files + 0.86 x slides. Keynote 16 on one Mac; refit when the application, the machine or the runner's steps change.
